recommendations: Restore real authorisation: SecurityConfig.java:19 permits everything, so the module is fully anonymous. Define rules and register JwtTokenFilter with addFilterBefore() - today the @Component filter runs only as a servlet filter, its Authentication is consulted by nothing, and a bad token becomes a RuntimeException (JwtTokenFilter.java:42) rather than a 401.

Fix the /users/{id} vs /users/{username} collision (UserController.java:47 vs :70): the numeric handler shadows the username handler and a non-numeric segment fails Long conversion. Rename to /users/by-username/{username} or drop the route.
Delete or implement POST /users/login (UserController.java:117-122) - it hashes the controller's own toString() and returns null.
Implement UserServiceImpl.update() (62-68), which ignores its userRequest argument; PUT /users/{id} currently cannot change anything.

Wire the RBAC model or delete it: map UserRequest.role (UserRequest.java:18) to RoleEntity, add Role/Permission repositories plus a seed, and return a real authority string from RoleEntity.getAuthority() (36-39).

Complete or remove TOTP: nothing verifies a code (commented at UserController.java:52-59), no endpoint exposes the QR (UserResponse has no qrCode field), UserEntity.mfa (48) is never read. Do not describe the service as MFA-capable until then.
Stop storing the TOTP secret in plaintext in T_USERS.secret (UserEntity.java:26) - encrypting @Convert or a vault reference - and keep it out of any Lombok toString() that reaches a log.
Pin the enum contract: add @Enumerated(STRING) or a Converter keyed on Status.code (Status.java:10), then replace ddl-auto: update with Flyway.
Externalise the gateway URL (UserController.java:25) as a property, switch to lb://person-service with a @LoadBalanced RestTemplate, and set connect/read timeouts.
Add @Transactional(readOnly=true) to reads and real boundaries on create/update; move the duplicate-username check (UserServiceImpl.java:45-48) before the QR + BCrypt work.

Narrow UserGlobalExceptionHandler: replace the Exception catch-all (:34-39) with specific handlers, return 404 for the two not-found exceptions, keep ErrorResponse on every path, fix the 'Person Service' string.
Align the compiler: pom.xml:139-140 pins source/target 10 against the parent's Java 17.
Delete the unused commons-lang3 dependency (pom.xml:88-92); fix or remove QrCodeGenerator.java:19's absolute path to a stale checkout; drop the fictional Dockerfile EXPOSE 8080 or set server.port.

Add the first tests - src/test does not exist though the Boot test starter is declared. Highest value: UserMapper + UserStatusResolver (its default silently maps any unknown status to USER_ACCOUNT_ENABLE, :19-21), the exception handler, the duplicate-username path.
gaps: Driver class, dialect, ddl-auto value, datasource URL and server.port are outside this component (user-service ships only bootstrap.yml). ddl-auto: update / users_schema / :3307 are carried from .opencode/rules/development.md:44-45 and .opencode/rules/project/metadata.json:17 - not read from a file in scope.
Whether jwt.secret here is the same value used by gateway-service and auth-service is not determinable in scope; only the property name at JwtUtil.java:18 is visible.

Runtime behaviour of the duplicate /users/{x} mappings (which handler Spring selects, or whether startup fails) is a static inference - the application was not started and nothing was built; the bash budget is read-only.
Physical column names/types (secret, qr_code, person_id, TINYINT status) follow Hibernate implicit naming but are unverified - no schema, migration or test exists in the module.

Whether @Value on the final fields of JwtUtil (18-22) binds through Lombok's generated constructor was not verified by a build; no lombok.config exists in the module to copy @Value to constructor parameters.
